Rows 0,1,2 are populated; row3 contains null callbacks and zero flags, but no reviewed consumer treats it as a terminator. Common initialization requests IDs 0,1,2. Setup invokes init and schedules proc while ignoring callback1/flags. Row2 proc calls lb_800115F4 then Ground_801C2FE0; row1 calls only Ground_801C2FE0. Touch-line returns NULL, shadow-check true. Object2 init also passes (69,2,1,0,1) to grAnime_801C7FF8 and scans 40 s16 candidates before a -1 sentinel to register material callbacks. The response passes hidden flags and fixed effect/quake/audio arguments before a material call; objective-target identity is unverified. Detailed generator, animation and collision semantics remain delegated.
facts.rationale: Do not infer terminator consumption, visual identity or callee internals from table shape and aliases.
